# Benchmark results

*Generated by `scripts/results_md.py` from `eval/report_*.json`. Do not edit by hand: rerun the script.*

Gold set: **13 papers**, 91 fields, of which **43** are absent from the paper (NOT_FOUND). BM25 retrieval, 3 passages per field, sections of at most 200 words. In brackets: 95% bootstrap interval.

## 1 · Main table

| Metric | teacher | student-base | student-lora |
|---|---|---|---|
| Correct field (gold set) | 0.81 [0.74 – 0.89] | 0.56 [0.46 – 0.67] | 0.71 [0.63 – 0.80] |
| Invented value when the field is absent ↓ | 0.02 [0.00 – 0.07] | 0.26 [0.12 – 0.40] | 0.07 [0.00 – 0.16] |
| NOT_FOUND when the field is absent | 0.98 [0.93 – 1.00] | 0.74 [0.60 – 0.88] | 0.93 [0.84 – 1.00] |
| Quote found in the paper | 0.94 [0.85 – 1.00] | 0.69 [0.57 – 0.82] | 0.84 [0.73 – 0.95] |
| Value found in its quote | 1.00 [1.00 – 1.00] | 0.82 [0.69 – 0.92] | 0.73 [0.57 – 0.86] |
| Agreement with the teacher | 1.00 [1.00 – 1.00] | 0.61 [0.52 – 0.71] | 0.83 [0.76 – 0.91] |
| Compiled protocol that converges (water) | — | — | — |
| Seconds per paper (median) | — | 18.09 | 19.79 |
| Model | claude (Cowork session) | models/qwen3-1.7b-4bit | models/qwen3-1.7b-4bit |
| Papers scored / failed | 13 / 0 | 13 / 0 | 13 / 0 |

The teacher row scores Claude's labels on the same passages as the student, so no timing or compilation is attributed to it.
